entries.retention: Originals stay on the configured library; directory cache is bounded and rebuildable.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS reachability plus re-probed capacity admission before writes.
entries.nasOffline: Pause the job and persist its cursor; never switch to local media storage.
entries.resume: Durable job cursor resumes only after the same library is reachable.
entries.duplicateProtection: Canonical active-library path and fingerprint rules prevent duplicate catalog rows.

entries.retention: Source and thumbnails remain NAS-backed; searchable rows are rebuildable database state.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS source access and capacity admission for generated derivatives; database writes are bounded.
entries.nasOffline: Pause source reads and enrichment writes; local model cache may remain bounded and rebuildable.
entries.resume: Retry from durable media identity without re-copying source bytes.
entries.duplicateProtection: Upsert by canonical media identity and normalized embedding dimensions.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: rebuildable AI rows only after explicit derived-data cleanup

entries.retention: Scratch is owned by the job; archive indexes and reports remain NAS-backed.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS temp directory and reserved capacity are required before extraction.
entries.nasOffline: Stop before or during extraction; do not use OS temp or delete the source archive.
entries.resume: Discard incomplete scratch and restart from the unchanged archive.
entries.duplicateProtection: Archive identity, path validation, and verified extracted-file hashes.

entries.retention: Recycle contents are recoverable and never reclaimed by capacity housekeeping.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS write admission before recycle; cleanup manifests stay in control-plane/NAS recovery state.
entries.nasOffline: Pause and leave originals untouched; interrupted cleanup remains retryable.
entries.resume: Manifest-backed actions retry idempotently and preserve completed moves.
entries.duplicateProtection: Canonical catalog scope, cleanup manifest identity, and explicit confirmation.

entries.retention: Verified backups and protected originals are retained; working output is disposable until applied.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS working directory plus reservation; protected backup creation fails closed.
entries.nasOffline: Pause conversion and keep the original and verified backup intact.
entries.resume: Recovery inspects durable conversion state and never treats partial output as complete.
entries.duplicateProtection: Format classification, canonical source identity, and verified output hashes.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: unapplied working output only after recovery rules

entries.retention: AI metadata is rebuildable; source media and derivatives remain NAS-backed.
entries.capacityGuard: Capacity admission for any derivative or staged output; cloud calls also require privacy consent.
entries.nasOffline: Pause NAS reads and writes; local fallback may not send data to a cloud provider.
entries.resume: Durable media identity allows retry without creating a second enrichment record.
entries.duplicateProtection: Database uniqueness and per-library job claims.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: rebuildable AI rows only through derived-data cleanup

entries.retention: Face crops are NAS-scoped rebuildable derivatives; verified model artifacts are bounded local cache.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS capacity admission for crops and checksum verification for model downloads.
entries.nasOffline: Pause derived face work; never copy face crops into OS temp or an unverified model path.
entries.resume: Advisory per-library lock and durable derived state make retries idempotent.
entries.duplicateProtection: Verified model artifacts, canonical media identity, and derived-row cleanup boundary.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: rebuildable face rows/crops only through explicit derived cleanup

entries.retention: Imported originals and operation history remain NAS-backed; temporary import scratch is job-owned.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS path validation and capacity reservation before copy or extraction.
entries.nasOffline: Fail closed before mutation or pause an interrupted import; never stage media locally.
entries.resume: Verified move/copy state and hashes permit safe retry without duplicate originals.
entries.duplicateProtection: Canonical library scope, path safety, and SHA-256 verification.

entries.destination: BROWSER_DEVICE or MOBILE_DEVICE only after explicit user download
entries.retention: Device downloads and Blob URLs are user-owned ephemeral exports, not library persistence.
entries.capacityGuard: Browser/mobile OS controls device space; the server does not claim downloaded bytes as NAS storage.
entries.nasOffline: Existing device export may be opened locally; new server export requires the source NAS to be reachable.
entries.resume: User retries the download; no server-side local-media staging is implied.
entries.duplicateProtection: Download names are client concerns; server source identity remains canonical.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: browser/mobile device cache under platform controls

entries.retention: Lazy/reconciled thumbnails are bounded by the NAS cache policy and rebuildable.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS-only cache directory, quota, partial-file exclusion, and capacity admission.
entries.nasOffline: Cancel or pause the thumbnail job without falling back to local cache.
entries.resume: Only restart-interrupted failed jobs resume; partial files are ignored and cleaned safely.
entries.duplicateProtection: Per-file lock, canonical media identity, and atomic publication.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: stale rebuildable thumbnail cache entries only

entries.destination: DATABASE control state + NAS-backed recovery artifacts
entries.retention: Job state, manifests, and verified backups survive restart; originals are never capacity fallbacks.
entries.capacityGuard: Unknown capacity, missing paths, permissions, and disconnected NAS fail closed.
entries.nasOffline: Persist PAUSED/READ_ONLY state and stop producers before shutdown or reconnect handling.
entries.resume: Restart/reconnect recovers durable job state and re-probes the active library before writes.
entries.duplicateProtection: Per-library database claims, manifest states, and canonical active-library scope.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: none for permanent archive or recovery knowledge

entries.retention: NAS operational history is bounded and redacted; launcher diagnostics remain local and bounded.
entries.capacityGuard: NAS log/report writes are bounded and skip unsafe writes; launcher log rotation caps local usage.
entries.nasOffline: Keep sensitive diagnostics private and report the failure without writing media-sized data locally.
entries.resume: Later operations append to the bounded stream; reports are atomic and independently recoverable.
entries.duplicateProtection: Atomic report names and operation identity; no source replacement.
entries.automaticReclaimSource: expired bounded logs only, never originals or verified backups
